name: Articles & explainers
description: Clear, well-structured articles that turn a difficult subject into something an intelligent general reader can follow.
deliverables: Blog posts, explainers, educational articles and thought-leadership drafts.
idealFor: Educators, founders, student organisations and small teams with expertise to share.

name: Website copy
kicker: Words with a job to do
description: Homepage, about-page and service copy that explains what you offer without sounding inflated or generic.
deliverables: Landing pages, service pages, brand messaging and copy rewrites.
idealFor: Small businesses, creators, community projects and early-stage brands.

name: Ghostwriting
description: Posts and articles shaped from your notes, interviews or rough drafts, with careful attention to tone and point of view.
deliverables: LinkedIn posts, founder articles, speeches, newsletters and personal essays.
idealFor: People with strong ideas but limited time to turn them into polished writing.

name: Editing & rewriting
description: Structural and line editing that improves logic, rhythm and readability while preserving the writer's meaning.
deliverables: Developmental edits, line edits, rewrites and before-and-after explanations.
idealFor: Students, independent writers, founders and teams working from an existing draft.
